about: DEV Community (dev.to) is a developer blogging platform. This CLI reads its public JSON API: articles (filtered, latest, top, rising, series), article details, comment threads, users, organizations, tags, podcast episodes and videos.

commands.summary: List published articles. Filter by one tag, any of several tags, excluded tags, author or organization username, feed state (fresh/rising), top articles of the last N days, or series (collection_id).

params.name: tag
params.description: Only articles with this single tag (no #), e.g. react

params.name: tags
params.description: Comma-separated tags; matches articles having any of these tags, e.g. react,javascript

params.name: tags_exclude
params.description: Comma-separated tags to exclude, e.g. ai

params.name: username
params.description: Only articles by this user or organization username

params.name: state
params.description: Feed state: 'fresh' for new articles, 'rising' for trending new articles

params.name: top
params.description: Most popular articles from the last N days, e.g. 7

params.name: collection_id
params.description: Only articles in this series/collection (the collection_id field of an article)

commands.summary: List the newest published articles, newest first.
Get one article by numeric id, with metadata, tags, author and full body (body_html/body_markdown).

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric article id (the id field from article lists)

commands.summary: Get one article by author username and slug (the two parts of its dev.to URL path).

params.name: username
params.description: Author or organization username (first URL path segment)

commands.summary: List all comment threads on an article. Each comment has nested replies in children.
Get one comment and all of its nested replies by comment id_code.
Get public reaction counts for the comments of an article, as a list of {id: numeric comment id, count}.
Get a user's public profile by username.
Get a user's public profile by numeric user id.
Get an organization's profile by its username.
List articles published under an organization.
List the members of an organization.
List recent podcast episodes hosted on DEV.
List recent articles that contain a video.
